title: Accelerating the “one-pot” melt polycondensation for thermotropic liquid crystalline polymers by introducing a second acetylating agent
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43676-43682
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07423A, Paper
Open Access

Hua Zeng, Xiaoyi Sun, Qian Li, Sheng Song
We developed a new strategy to significantly accelerate the efficiency of the production of thermotropic liquid crystalline polymers (TLCPs) by introducing a second acetylating agent derived from commercial polyphenols.
